nusmp.compass3d.title: Compass Magic in 3D
nusmp.compass3d.body: Compass Magic is one floating 3D compass beside you: a thick bronze rim, a green dial, a raised cream and gold compass rose, a gold needle and a glass dome, with a spiky yellow aura behind it. It appears when you cast or hold a Compass page, its needle swings to your target and it fades a few seconds later. Every Compass spell comes out of it as 3D models: arrow-needles that leave the compass, seal discs that fly to your foes' feet, a route of dashes to the charted foe, and a turn disc where Willful Compass bends a shot back.
nusmp.compass3d.config: Draw Compass Magic as one 3D compass with 3D spell models (visual.compass3d in config/nusmp-compass3d-client.toml). Off draws the old flat compasses, needle and lock sigil instead.
nusmp.compass3d.aura: The spiky yellow aura behind the 3D compass and the glint that runs round its rim (visual.compass3d_aura).
